source: Onkelos on Exod 38:8; the mirrors' story at Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 9:4 with 9:1 and 9:2
claim_en: The laver of copper from the mirrors of the women — the received translation renders them women WHO CAME TO PRAY at the Tent's entrance: the modesty track (Onkelos Exod 38). The spine runs the other track whole: Pharaoh's decree against the homes; the women's counter-operation — the little fish in the jugs, the meals in the field, the mirror-courtship arousing desire under the crushing labor, the hosts conceived; the women bring THE MIRRORS as their gift; MOSES IS ANGRY — and the Holy One overrules him: THESE MIRRORS RAISED ALL THE HOSTS — make from them the laver and its base, the priests' own sanctification-source (Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 9:4, the backstory at 9:1). The fecundity census rides as a four-way ink-count on the verbs — two, six, twelve, six hundred thousand per womb (Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 9:2). Both tracks carried. Seated under the amended spine, auto-seat law.

source: Onkelos on Exod 38:21-23; the two-signatory rule at Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 5:2 with 3:2 and 5:3; the pre-commitment at Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 7:4 with 7:1; the case row Mishnah Shekalim 3:2
claim_en: THESE ARE THE ACCOUNTS — counted AT THE WORD OF MOSES, the Levites' service under ITAMAR son of Aaron (Onkelos Exod 38): the audit self-ordered, the second hand on the books. The spine's law: no money-office over the public with FEWER THAN TWO (Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 3:2) — Moses exempt by the trusted-in-all-My-house verse, YET he calls others and reckons THROUGH them (Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 5:2): the waiver declined in practice. The treasury dress-code rides — no hemmed cloak, no money-belt, no felt shoes in the chamber, for a man must be CLEAN BEFORE THE LORD AND BEFORE ISRAEL (Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 5:3; the rule's case row at Mishnah Shekalim 3:2, this exam's docket); and the why: he HEARD THE SCOFFERS — 'a man over unweighed talents, you want him not rich?' — and vowed the public accounting at completion (Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 7:4), everything in the house by NUMBER AND WEIGHT, the weights written (Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 7:1). Seated under the amended spine, auto-seat law.

All the gold of the work: twenty-nine talents seven hundred thirty — the shekel rendered SELAIM, BY THE SELAIM OF THE SANCTUARY; the census silver a hundred talents and 1,775 selaim by the same standard (Onkelos Exod 38): the conversion-layer of EX30-10 running live on the audit lines — the denomination floats, the ledger holds.

source: Onkelos on Exod 38:26-27; the docket row Mishnah Shekalim 1:4
claim_en: A beka a head — HALF A SELA by the Sanctuary standard — for every one passing the count from twenty up: six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty; a hundred talents cast the hundred sockets, A TALENT PER SOCKET (Onkelos Exod 38): the half-shekel machine's roll closed at the unit-cost line, and the priests' own liability sits on the case shelf at the same verse (Mishnah Shekalim 1:4, this exam's docket).

source: Onkelos on Exod 38:28; the reconciliation at Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 7:3; the attribution flip at Midrash Tanchuma Buber, Pekudei 4:1
claim_en: Mid-accounting Moses forgets where the 1,775 selaim went — the hooks, invisible from where he stood — and dreads the finding ('now they will say I took them'); the Holy One ILLUMINATES HIS EYES, he looks up, SEES THE HOOKS ON THE PILLARS, and answers in a loud voice: the 1,775 made hooks for the pillars — and Israel was satisfied (Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 7:3, on the ink of Onkelos Exod 38): the audit gap closed by physical inventory. The Buber recension carries the praise-and-scorn dispute with the SPEAKERS SWAPPED against the Ki Tisa recension — R. Isaac the praise, R. Chama the fat-neck scorn — a recorded attribution-variance between recensions, carried as such (Midrash Tanchuma Buber, Pekudei 4:1). Seated under the amended spine, auto-seat law.

source: Onkelos on Exod 38:29-31; the surplus declaration at Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 5:5; the receipt doctrine at Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 2:5 with 6:1 and 2:4
claim_en: The copper books to the stake-level (Onkelos Exod 38); the surplus line published inside the accounting — 'such-and-such went to the tabernacle, and WITH THE EXCESS I made the tabernacle of the testimony' (Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 5:5). And the testimony decoded: the tabernacle is the PUBLIC RECEIPT of the calf's pardon — 'who will tell the nations You are reconciled?' answered by the indwelling command itself (Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 2:5), the perfume rising from the reconciled house the nations' proof (Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 6:1); the doubled tabernacle-word read as the double mortgage — seized twice as pledge (Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 2:4). Seated under the amended spine, auto-seat law.

source: Midrash Tanchuma, Vayakhel 4:5; the full table at Midrash Tanchuma Buber, Vayakhel 3:1
claim_en: Named-with-pedigree for PRAISE: Oholiab son of Ahisamach of DAN — praise to him, his family, his tribe; named-with-pedigree for SCORN: Shelomith daughter of Dibri of DAN (the blasphemer's mother) and Achan of JUDAH (Midrash Tanchuma, Vayakhel 4:5) — the Buber recension completing the two-by-two: Bezalel of JUDAH the praise-pole against Achan (Midrash Tanchuma Buber, Vayakhel 3:1). The same two tribes carry both poles — the convention Leviticus 24 will meet from the disgrace side at the first recorded call into the machine. Seated under the amended spine, auto-seat law.

THE DOUBLE MANEH COMPUTED. 'The brass of the offering: seventy talents and 2,400 shekels' — ninety-six maneh stand in the shekel figure, counted in SMALL CHANGE rather than rounded into a talent: the sanctuary maneh was DOUBLE — a metrological constant derived from the inventory's own refusal to round, the inference argued at both edges and standing. The audit chapter yields a unit definition. Filed F-102, auto-seated (round 26, the sanctuary block).

source: Onkelos Exod 38:8, 38:21-31; Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 3:2, 5:2-3, 7:1-4, 9:4, Vayakhel 4:5; Bekhorot 5a:18; Mishnah Shekalim 1:3-4, 3:2, 5:2; Middot 3:6
claim_en: THE TALENT COMPUTED FROM THE CENSUS — THE ACCOUNTS' TWO SIGNATORIES, THE HUNDRED SOCKETS, THE SILVER HEADS THE RUN ADDS. Exod 38:21-31 in cold_run_sanctuary_build.py: the talent = 3,000 shekels from 603,550 half-shekels against a hundred talents and 1,775; the books balance; 2,400 bronze shekels = ninety-six maneh, the sanctuary maneh doubled (Bekhorot 5a); two signatories = Shekalim 5:2; a hundred sockets = the spec's ninety-six plus four; the heads' silver overlay added at 38:17, 38:19 and accounted at 38:28; the sanctuary shekel thrice; a beka with Gen 24:22; the census with Num 1:46; no stamp in 36-38; the mirrors on two tracks; the assembling women with 1 Sam 2:22; the laver, incense altar, oil, and half shekel owed to E4.
